national.line: In South Carolina, a group of children wrote goodbye letters for a senior shelter dog, and the letters went viral and got him adopted.
A high school teacher in Sandy Springs, Georgia, found a tiny black cat stuck in her car engine on her way to work, just in time for her Halloween wedding anniversary.

A retired couple in Beaverton, Oregon, got a brand-new heating and cooling system worth sixteen thousand dollars for free through a program called Feel the Love that has helped thirty-one hundred people.
A couple who dreamed of buying a certain house as teenagers slipped a handwritten note under its door twenty years later, and that note led to the house becoming theirs.
A woman accidentally ended a work call by telling an important client "Love you," and he answered so kindly that he even followed up with a heartwarming email.
Actor Brendan Fraser surprised a theater full of fans by showing up in costume at a screening of his movie The Mummy.
Rescuers used a remote-controlled crawler built to look like R2-D2 from Star Wars to help get a kitten out of a drain pipe.
A crew of Ameren utility workers got a happy reunion with a stray dog they had helped rescue.
A New York Knicks fan's hilarious Halloween display featuring Taylor Swift and Timothée Chalamet is going viral online.
Pepsi is rolling out a new holiday flavor called Pepsi Vanilla and Cream nationwide for a limited time, in both regular and Zero Sugar.
HGTV star Joanna Gaines posted a hilarious video of herself dancing with her sister, and fans are loving it.

local.line: Congratulations to Lebanon R-3 Schools on celebrating the opening of the new Robert W. Plaster Center for Student Success.
Congratulations to Lebanon R-3 Schools for earning a national Meritorious Budget Award.
Congratulations to three Lebanon High School tennis players who received All-District honors this season.
Congratulations to the Lebanon Yellowjackets marching band for placing at the Valhalla Marching Festival.
Congratulations to Brittany Stamm, who has been named the new head girls basketball coach for Lebanon R-3 Schools.
Congratulations to Kalem Copling, who has been named the new head boys basketball coach for Lebanon R-3 Schools.
Lebanon R-3 Schools says its Hive Depot is providing essential resources and learning opportunities for Lebanon students.
A local church in Lebanon came together to build a ramp for a woman with a disability, according to the Laclede County Record.
Congratulations to the angler who set a new world record at Lake of the Ozarks by landing a 164-pound paddlefish.
The Fall Harbor Hop drew nearly twenty-three hundred boaters out for a sunny day on Lake of the Ozarks.
New details are out on a 126-room Hyatt hotel planned in the Backwater Jacks' cove at Lake of the Ozarks.
Patrick Mahomes' mom has set the record straight: the Chiefs quarterback does not have a home at Lake of the Ozarks.
Camdenton celebrated its Homecoming with a parade and the crowning of this year's Homecoming royalty.
Lake of the Ozarks hit a new heat record on Tuesday.

music.line: The Country Music Hall of Fame has officially inducted its class of 2026: Tim McGraw, Paul Overstreet and The Stanley Brothers.
Luke Bryan is hitting a big milestone on American Idol, a full decade as a judge, and he is sharing what he expects from season twenty-five.
Ella Langley is celebrating one full year of her massive hit Choosin' Texas, saying she is constantly and consistently amazed.
Megan Moroney made country music history by performing at the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show.
Zach Top has released two new songs, Good Girls and Cowgirls and Other Side of Hurtin'.
Zach Bryan says Morgan Wallen and Jason Isbell helped change his mind about Nashville, admitting the chip on his shoulder was his own.
Trace Adkins is celebrating thirty years of his album Dreamin' Out Loud with its first-ever vinyl release.
Vince Gill has a new album with Marty Stuart called Marty and Me, and reviewers say it is twangy and tasty from the very start.
Red Dirt favorites Turnpike Troubadours will headline two nights at Red Rocks in 2027.
